title: A mast cell gatekeeper for skull–dura–brain inflammation after stroke
title_zh: 卒中后颅骨-硬脑膜-脑炎症的肥大细胞门控
abstract: Wang et al. propose that post-stroke inflammation is driven not only by disruption of the blood–brain barrier, but also by immune signalling between the skull, meninges and brain. They conclude that targeting dural mast cells may help limit early inflammatory injury after stroke.
abstract_zh: 王等人提出，卒中后炎症不仅由血脑屏障破坏驱动，还由颅骨、脑膜与脑之间的免疫信号传递所促成。他们得出结论，靶向硬脑膜肥大细胞可能有助于限制卒中后早期炎症损伤。
